finding.title: Extract the 3x-duplicated 4-path file-candidate search in epic_25_story_25_20_locale_theme_test.dart into one helper
finding.why: The identical 4-item candidate list (lib/app/learning_tracker_app.dart, learning_tracker/lib/app/..., lib/main.dart, learning_tracker/lib/main.dart) plus a near-identical linear-search-and-read loop is pasted three times in one file: once in the AC2/AC3 setUpAll (which caches the result as mainSource) and again inside two separate AC9 tests that re-scan and re-read the same files from disk instead of reusing mainSource. A future path change has to be applied in three places in this file alone; missing one silently leaves a structural AC check reading stale content without failing loudly.
finding.recommendation: Factor the candidate list and search loop into one shared helper (or simply reuse the cached mainSource from the AC2/AC3 group) and call it from all three sites.
acceptance_criteria: only one copy of the 4-path candidate list remains in the file
AC9's two tests reuse the same source read as AC2/AC3 instead of re-scanning disk

finding.title: Deduplicate TrackCreationService/TrackEditService's verbatim study-day persistence loop
finding.rule: Fowler duplication + DB-3 (batch()/insertAll over awaited per-row loops)
finding.why: _saveStudyDaysLocal (track_creation_service.dart:348-368) and _saveStudyDays (track_edit_service.dart:95-115) are byte-for-byte identical except a parameter name — the exact 'delete then loop-await-upsert' method copy-pasted into two sibling services. A future fix (validation, batching, a new column) applied to one copy silently leaves the other stale. Both loops (plus the unbounded _saveScopes loop) await each row individually instead of using Drift's batch()/insertAll, even though they already run inside an open transaction() so correctness is not at risk — only round-trip count.
finding.recommendation: Extract one shared DAO-level batched helper (e.g. StudyDayConfigDao.replaceAll using batch()) and call it from both services; do the same for _saveScopes.
acceptance_criteria: One shared helper implements the delete+insert study-day/scope replacement using batch()/insertAll
TrackCreationService and TrackEditService both call it; no duplicate method body remains

finding.title: Delete the duplicate readInIsrael/writeInIsrael test group in sacred_time_preferences_test.dart
finding.why: The group at line 191 tests the exact same three scenarios as the group at line 171 (default-false, true-after-write, false-after-write-false) with only the test names changed. It adds no coverage and doubles the maintenance cost of any future change to these methods' behavior.
finding.recommendation: Delete the second (line 191-209) group; it is fully subsumed by the first.
acceptance_criteria: No assertions are lost when the duplicate group is removed

finding.title: Stop interpolating raw error.toString() into localized error messages across progress screens
finding.rule: EH-5 / custom_lint no_e_to_string_in_ui (currently enforcing nothing repo-wide)
finding.why: error.toString() on a Dart/Firebase/Drift exception is always in English (e.g. 'Bad state: ...', 'SqliteException: ...') and not ICU-pluralizable; interpolating it into an otherwise-Hebrew ARB string means a Hebrew-locale, RTL user who hits any of these error states sees a sentence that switches to raw untranslated English mid-string. recent_activity_screen.dart in the same directory shows the correct pattern (l10n.chartFailedToLoad with no error interpolation, 4 uses) — the other 4 screens in this same feature diverge from it.
finding.recommendation: Replace error.toString() interpolation with the generic localized failure string (as recent_activity_screen.dart already does) and, if diagnostic detail is genuinely needed, log error.toString() via AppLogger instead of rendering it to the user.
acceptance_criteria: None of the 4 screens' AsyncValue.error branches call .toString() on the error object inside a Text/l10n call.
Once dart run custom_lint is repaired, no_e_to_string_in_ui reports zero hits in lib/features/progress/.

finding.title: Cache the account list Future instead of constructing it fresh inside AccountPickerScreen.build()
finding.why: registry.getAllAccounts() is called directly inside `Widget build()`, which returns a brand-new Future object on every rebuild. FutureBuilder tracks futures by identity, so any unrelated rebuild of this ConsumerWidget (a ref.watch(accountDbFileNameProvider) change from switching accounts, a locale/theme change, or any ancestor rebuild) restarts the FutureBuilder into ConnectionState.waiting — flashing the loading spinner over the already-rendered account list and re-querying the device registry — the textbook 'Future-in-build' Flutter anti-pattern.
finding.recommendation: Hoist the fetch behind a FutureProvider/AsyncNotifier (e.g. deviceAccountsProvider watched via ref.watch), or convert to ConsumerStatefulWidget and cache the Future in State so its identity is stable across rebuilds.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test triggers an unrelated provider rebuild while AccountPickerScreen is mounted and asserts the list does not revert to the loading spinner and getAllAccounts() is not invoked a second time
